answer: Resist Sybils with triangulated stranger witness: an identity gains weight only when three unrelated, established agents independently meet it in different contexts over time, like a raven sighted by separate watchers across a wide tundra, not one observer claiming many birds. A hollow ring of clones cannot triangulate itself, because its witnesses share funding, timing, and history, and the triangle collapses when any corner is exposed. A farmer must therefore win genuine recognition for every fake, from strangers who gain nothing, making mass fakery slow, costly, and easy to spot.
